# Data Wrangling
```{r data wrangling}

# Part 1 
df_name <- read_excel("./12-13-22+Twitter+Profile+Experiment+Description+Pretest_December+14%2C+2022_15.00.xlsx", n_max = 0) %>%
            names()

df_name <- str_replace(df_name, "_9_TEXT" , "TEXT")

df_Qualtrics1 <- read_excel("./12-13-22+Twitter+Profile+Experiment+Description+Pretest_December+14%2C+2022_15.00.xlsx",
                            skip = 2,
                            col_names = df_name) 

df_Qualtrics1 <- df_Qualtrics1 %>%
  filter(CompletionCode == "4NRUJGE8") 

df_Qualtrics_long1 <- df_Qualtrics1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `1_feelings_therm_1`:`3_PO_TARGET`, 
                names_to = c("BioNo", "Attributes"),
                names_pattern = "(\\d)_(.*)",
                values_to = "Value")


df_Qualtrics_lw <- df_Qualtrics_long1 %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Attributes",
              values_from = "Value") %>%
  rename(feelings_therm = feelings_therm_1)

df_Qualtrics_lw <- df_Qualtrics_lw %>%
  mutate(
    BioSet_Phrase = NA_character_,
    BioSet_PhraseOrder = NA_character_,
    BioSet_Partisan = NA_character_,
    BioSet_PartisanOrder = NA_character_
  )

df_Qualtrics_lw <- df_Qualtrics_lw %>%
  mutate(
    BioSet_Partisan_1 = replace_na(BioSet_Partisan_1, "NAPartisan"),
    BioSet_Partisan_2 = replace_na(BioSet_Partisan_2, "NAPartisan"),
    BioSet_Partisan_3 = replace_na(BioSet_Partisan_3, "NAPartisan")
  )


df_Qualtrics_lw <- df_Qualtrics_lw %>%
  mutate(
    BioSet_Phrase = case_when(
      !is.na(BioPhraseSet_1) ~ as.character(BioPhraseSet_1),
      !is.na(BioPhraseSet_2) ~ paste(BioSet_Phrase, as.character(BioPhraseSet_2), sep = ", "),
      !is.na(BioPhraseSet_3) ~ paste(BioSet_Phrase, as.character(BioPhraseSet_3), sep = ", "),
      TRUE ~ BioSet_Phrase  
    ),
    BioSet_PhraseOrder = paste(
      BioPhraseSet_1,
      BioPhraseSet_2,
      BioPhraseSet_3,
      sep = ", "
    ),
    BioSet_Partisan = case_when(
      !is.na(BioSet_Partisan_1) ~ as.character(BioSet_Partisan_1),
      !is.na(BioSet_Partisan_2) ~ paste(BioSet_Partisan, as.character(BioSet_Partisan_2), sep = ", "),
      !is.na(BioSet_Partisan_3) ~ paste(BioSet_Partisan, as.character(BioSet_Partisan_3), sep = ", "),
      TRUE ~ BioSet_Partisan  
    ),
    BioSet_PartisanOrder = paste(
      BioSet_Partisan_1,
      BioSet_Partisan_2,
      BioSet_Partisan_3,
      sep = ", "
    )
  )


df_Qualtrics_lw <- df_Qualtrics_lw %>% mutate(BioSet_Partisan = replace_na(BioSet_Partisan, "None,"))
df_Qualtrics_lw$Full_Bio <- paste0(df_Qualtrics_lw$BioSet_Partisan, " ", df_Qualtrics_lw$BioSet_Phrase)

df_Qualtrics_lw$RaterPartisan_BioPhrase <- paste0(df_Qualtrics_lw$party_binary, "-Rater, ", df_Qualtrics_lw$BioSet_Phrase)


# Part 2 
df_name2 <- read_excel("./12-13-22+Twitter+Profile+Experiment+Description+Pretest+-+Part2_December+19%2C+2022_16.38.xlsx", n_max = 0) %>%
            names()

df_name2 <- str_replace(df_name2, "_9_TEXT" , "TEXT")

df_Qualtrics2 <- read_excel("./12-13-22+Twitter+Profile+Experiment+Description+Pretest+-+Part2_December+19%2C+2022_16.38.xlsx",
                            skip = 2,
                            col_names = df_name2)

df_Qualtrics2 <- df_Qualtrics2 %>%
  filter(CompletionCode == "4NRUJGE8")

df_Qualtrics_long <- df_Qualtrics2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `1_feelings_therm_1`:`5_PO_TARGET`, 
                names_to = c("BioNo", "Attributes"),
                names_pattern = "(\\d)_(.*)",
                values_to = "Value")


df_Qualtrics_l2w <- df_Qualtrics_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Attributes",
              values_from = "Value") %>%
  rename(feelings_therm = feelings_therm_1)

df_Qualtrics_l2w$BioSet_Phrase <- "NA"
df_Qualtrics_l2w$BioSet_PhraseOrder <- "NA"

for (i in 1:nrow(df_Qualtrics_l2w)) {
  
  df_Qualtrics_l2w[i,(ncol(df_Qualtrics_l2w)-1):ncol(df_Qualtrics_l2w)] <- 
    df_Qualtrics_l2w[i,colnames(df_Qualtrics_l2w %>% select(ends_with(df_Qualtrics_l2w$BioNo[i])))]

}

df_Qualtrics_l2w$RaterPartisan_BioPhrase <- paste0(df_Qualtrics_l2w$party_binary, "-Rater, ", df_Qualtrics_l2w$BioSet_Phrase)


```

# Summary by group: PO_TARGET
  
```{r}

# Part 1 
PO_TARGET_ttest_byBioPartisan1 <- df_Qualtrics_lw %>%
  compare_means(PO_TARGET ~ BioSet_Partisan, data = .,
                group.by = "RaterPartisan_BioPhrase",
                method = "t.test")

PO_TARGET_Sum_byBioPartisan1 <- df_Qualtrics_lw %>%
  group_by(RaterPartisan_BioPhrase, BioSet_Partisan, BioSet_Phrase, party_binary) %>%
  get_summary_stats(PO_TARGET, type = "mean_sd") %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n:sd,
              names_from = BioSet_Partisan
              ) %>%
  left_join(PO_TARGET_ttest_byBioPartisan1, by = "RaterPartisan_BioPhrase")


# Part 2 
PO_TARGET_ttest_bymturkerPartisan <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  compare_means(PO_TARGET ~ party_binary, data = .,
                group.by = "BioSet_Phrase", #Full_Bio
                method = "t.test")

PO_TARGET_Sum_byRaterParty <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(BioSet_Phrase, party_binary) %>% #Full_Bio, BioSet_Partisan, 
  get_summary_stats(PO_TARGET, type = "mean_sd") %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n:sd,
              names_from = party_binary
              ) %>%
  left_join(PO_TARGET_ttest_bymturkerPartisan, by = "BioSet_Phrase")

```

# ORDER 
```{r}

# Part 1 
df_order_ttest <- compare_means(PO_TARGET ~ BioSet_PhraseOrder, 
                                df_Qualtrics_l2w, 
                                group.by = "BioSet_Phrase", #Full_Bio
                                method = "t.test")


df_order_Sum_byOrder <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(BioSet_Phrase, BioSet_PhraseOrder) %>% #Full_Bio
  get_summary_stats(PO_TARGET, type = "mean_sd")%>%
  mutate(Order = rep(LETTERS[1:2], length.out = n())) %>%
  select(-BioSet_PhraseOrder) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n:sd,
              names_from = Order
              ) %>%
  left_join(df_order_ttest, by = "BioSet_Phrase")

# Part 2 
df_order_ttest2 <- compare_means(PO_TARGET ~ BioSet_PhraseOrder, 
                                df_Qualtrics_l2w, 
                                group.by = "BioSet_Phrase", #Full_Bio
                                method = "t.test")


df_order_Sum_byOrder2 <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(BioSet_Phrase, BioSet_PhraseOrder) %>% #Full_Bio
  get_summary_stats(PO_TARGET, type = "mean_sd")%>%
  mutate(Order = rep(LETTERS[1:2], length.out = n())) %>%
  select(-BioSet_PhraseOrder) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n:sd,
              names_from = Order
              ) %>%
  left_join(df_order_ttest2, by = "BioSet_Phrase")
```

# Write Results into EXCEL
```{r eval=FALSE}

# Part 1
ls_df1 <- ls()[str_detect(ls(), "_Sum_")]
for (i in 1:length(ls_df1)){
   eval(
    parse(
      
      text = paste0(
        "write.xlsx( x=",
        ls_df1[i],
        ", file='OUTPUT_Ttest",
        Sys.Date(),
        ".xlsx',sheetName='",
        ls_df1[i],
        "', append = TRUE)"
      )
    )
  )
}

bioprase_lst1 <- unique(df_Qualtrics_lw$BioSet_Phrase)

for (i in bioprase_lst1) {
  print(i)
  df_Qualtrics_lw %>%
  subset(party_binary == 2) %>%
  subset(BioSet_Phrase == i) %>%
  t.test(PO_TARGET~1, 
         mu=4, 
         data = .) %>%
    print()
  
}

# Part 2
```
